result: Verified legacy and version 3 DXV playback in the bundled app, including translucent Normal and High Quality. Full extended-format qualification remains open.

baseline.observed: The four DXT samples played, but their 99th-percentile color error was 17 code values. Both high-quality profiles returned an unsupported color matrix error.

bundle.decoder: Pinned FFmpeg software decode with MapGyver's native upload and output path
bundle.comparison: Independent FFmpeg reference decode. The high-quality reference uses zimg's full-range YCgCo conversion. Alpha samples are composited over the same solid yellow test surface.

software.highQualityColorAndPartialAlpha: Full-range YUVA420P conversion preserves alpha and RGB through resizing.

highQualityAlphaFollowUp.fixture: Deterministic DXD3 MOV with literal YG10 BC5 blocks. Resolume Alley was installed and its desktop connection was unavailable. The installed Resolume clips checked were Normal Quality.
highQualityAlphaFollowUp.result: Passed all six existing profile checks and the moving Normal Quality regression in the same run. The High Quality result covers the tested YG10 literal-packet clip and the independent nonlinear color reference with a linear-light yellow composite.

remaining: Sustained DXV performance and resource acceptance, additional MKV profiles, and extended-format recovery remain open.
